name: Announceo – Scrolling Notification Bar
author: Inu Etc

sections.description:
Announceo – Scrolling Notification Bar lets you display important announcements, offers, or messages at the top of your website in a clean and distraction-free way.

You can choose between static text or smooth scrolling text, customize colors, font size, font family, and even add clickable links using the built-in WordPress editor.

The plugin is lightweight, responsive on all screen sizes, and designed to follow WordPress.org best practices for performance and compatibility.

Short Description

A lightweight, responsive scrolling notification bar for WordPress.

Features

  • Enable or disable the notification bar easily
  • Static or scrolling text mode
  • Adjustable scrolling speed
  • Responsive on all screen sizes
  • WordPress editor support (bold, italic, links, etc.)
  • Background color and text color controls
  • Custom link color and hover color
  • Font size control
  • Font family selection (inherit or common fonts)
  • Pause scrolling on hover
  • Clean, lightweight, and performance-friendly
  • No ads, no tracking, no bloat

Use Cases

  • Announce special offers or discounts
  • Display important notices or updates
  • Show maintenance or downtime messages
  • Promote events or limited-time announcements
  • Share important links or calls to action

Support & Feedback

If you enjoy using Announceo – Scrolling Notification Ba, please consider leaving a review to help it reach more people, supporting me on Buy Me a Coffee to motivate me to work on more interesting projects, or you can visit my website to learn more about me, hire me, or collaborate with me. Your support means the world and keeps me inspired to build creative and useful tools for the community.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. Announceo is lightweight and only loads minimal CSS and JavaScript when needed.

Can I add links inside the notification text?

Yes. The text field uses the WordPress editor, so you can add links, bold text, italics, and more.

Can I pause the scrolling on hover?

Yes. Scrolling automatically pauses when a user hovers over the notification bar.

Will it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The notification bar is fully responsive and works on all screen sizes.

Can I change colors and font size?

Yes. You can customize background color, text color, link color, hover color, font size, and font family.

Where does the notification bar appear?

The bar appears at the top of your website, above the main content.
